o.text: From ha- (“interrogative stem”) + yan (“side”). ha- is inherited from Proto-Turkic *ka-. For similar formations, see hara (“where”) and havaxt (“when”), from ara (“space”) and vaxt (“time”).
Borrowed from Russian премьера (premʹjera), itself derived from French première.
